legal_parent_evidence: Frozen E006 averaged OOF predictions, used only as an already cross-fitted comparator and anchor
Visible-prefix TVT and GR from the same horizontal well
Full supplied horizontal GR and geometry, including target-free hidden-suffix GR
forbidden_inputs: actual hidden-suffix TVT used to define fingerprints, slopes, candidates, thresholds, or reliability
typewell GR or TVT used by the self-correlation leg
visible test authoring examples used as hidden-test evidence
public leaderboard feedback used for candidate or threshold selection
external labels, copied predictions, or opaque artifacts

visible_only_design.selection_scope: The final visible-prefix segment is treated as pseudo-hidden. Actual hidden-suffix TVT is forbidden during design.
visible_only_design.boundary_leakage_guard: Every local U-slope target and prior window must end strictly before the pseudo-boundary; centered windows touching the pseudo-hidden segment are forbidden.
visible_only_design.absolute_residual_transfer: rejected before pre-registration because every tested strength materially worsened visible-only pseudo-holdout RMSE

self_correlation.gr_normalization_population: all finite GR rows in the supplied horizontal well
self_correlation.correction_formula: raw U is integrated from last visible U using matched visible local U slopes; raw TVT = raw U - Z; bounded self-correlation path = E006 + cap*tanh((raw TVT - E006)/cap)

placement.tie_break: lower self-correlation weight then frozen candidate order

reliability.transform: deterministic empirical percentile with well_id tie break; higher pseudo gain, coverage, and margin are favorable; lower distance is favorable
reliability.score_formula: arithmetic mean of four favorable percentiles clipped to [0,1]

validation.weight_fit: For each outer cell, fit only the placement weight/reliability reference on the other four folds using frozen E006 OOF and target-free self-correlation paths. Apply to the untouched fold.
validation.stress_weight_fit: Fit placement only on the other stress groups; typewell information defines evaluator groups but never enters the self-correlation predictor.

selection.rule: Among eligible candidates passing every frozen gate, select the lowest mean repeated-map RMSE; break ties by candidate_order. If none pass, reject E007 and retain E006.

edge_cases: all missing or constant horizontal GR
visible or hidden GR coverage below threshold
fewer than the minimum template states or query anchors
equal fingerprint distances and repeated motifs
one-row and very long hidden suffixes
soft-cap saturation over long cumulative drift
missing horizontal or parent OOF well
parent OOF hash or comparator RMSE mismatch
shuffled correction with different source and recipient lengths
non-finite slope, diagnostic, weight, path, or output
duplicate, missing, extra, wrong-order, visible-row, or non-finite sample predictions
